explanation.en: The holiday had another name until 1982: Dominion Day, for the day this country began governing itself. Its official name now is Canada Day.
explanation.fr: La fête portait un autre nom jusqu'en 1982 : le jour du Dominion, en souvenir du jour où le pays a commencé à se gouverner lui-même. Son nom officiel est maintenant la fête du Canada.

source.quote: Until 1982, July 1 was celebrated as “Dominion Day” to commemorate the day that Canada became a self-governing Dominion.

verification.evidence: Until 1982, July 1 was celebrated as “Dominion Day” to commemorate the day that Canada became a self-governing Dominion. Today it is officially known as Canada Day.
